verdict.rationale: Payout scheduling and per-payout reconciliation are fair questions for a payment platform, so this story applies to dLocal. The evidence only mentions settlements, "detailed reports," and mass payouts to third parties (disbursements). None of it documents merchant control over the settlement schedule or an itemized breakdown of the charges, fees, and refunds in each payout.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can control the payout schedule and see exactly which charges, fees, and refunds make up each payout
